params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to filter runners by. Cannot be used together with resource-class.

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class to filter runners by. Cannot be used together with namespace.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of self-hosted runners filtered by namespace or resource class. At least one filter parameter must be provided to return results. Returns details including hostname, name, connection timestamps, version, and resource class.

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class to query unclaimed tasks for

items.docs: Returns the number of unclaimed tasks for a given resource class. This endpoint is scoped to a single resource class, so it must be called per resource class to get totals across all classes.

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class to query running tasks for

items.docs: Returns the number of running tasks for a given resource class. This endpoint is scoped to a single resource class, so it must be called per resource class to get totals across all classes.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace to list resource classes for

items.docs: Returns a list of runner resource classes for the specified namespace. Resource classes define the compute resources available for self-hosted runner jobs.

Creates a new resource class for the specified namespace. Returns a resource class token that is only displayed once and cannot be retrieved again. This token is used by runner agents to authenticate.

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class in namespace/name format

items.docs: Returns details about a specific resource class.

params.name: resource-class
params.description: The resource class in namespace/name format

items.docs: Deletes a resource class. This will prevent any runners using this resource class from picking up new tasks.
